records.title: Employment Generation for Fishermen
details: a: The proposal for establishment of a Regional Centre of the Nation Fisheries Development Board (NFDB) at Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala has been taken with the Government of Kerala. The State Government has been requested to identify and allot suitable land at Thiruvananthapuram for setting up the proposed Centre and the response from State Government is awaited.

records.title: GNSS Spoofing Incidents.
details: b to c): Wireless Monitoring Organization (WMO) is investigating the matter.

records.title: Ongoing NH Construction in Kerala
details: d: Expert Committee visited the entire stretch of NH-66 in Kerala between 11.06.2025 to 14.07.2025 to assess the adequacy of the protection methodologies adopted/being adopted/ proposed to be adopted for slopes/embankments and other vulnerable locations and to suggest necessary improvements. Report of the committee is awaited.

records.title: Construction of New ESI Hospital
details: Yes, a proposal has been received to the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) for construction of an Out Patient block and Operation Theatre complex at the ESI hospital at Alappuzha (Kerela).

records.title: DELAYS IN FLIGHT SERVICES
details: the strike incident of Air India Express also happened. The DGCA is going into its depth and investigating the issue. If there seems to be any non-compliance by the airlines, then we are definitely going to penalise them and ensure that the passenger is the top priority.
